set.body: The single-decision ref_assess repair was necessary but hosted Documentation still showed the initial training-data hash mismatch. digest_data uses serialization v3, which yields different SHA-256 values for identical compact ALTREP and materialized integer vectors. Switch new provenance hashes to serialization v2, record the hash version on fits/calibration/dynamics/bundles, and retain a v3 fallback for legacy objects.
set.title: Canonicalize provenance hashes across R representations
